+/*
+ * @test
+ * @summary Run the LambdaEagerInitTest.java test in CDSAppTester::AOT workflow
+ *          and -Djdk.internal.lambda.disableEagerInitialization=true
+ * @bug 8391690
+ * @requires vm.cds.supports.aot.class.linking
+ * @library /test/lib
+ * @compile ../../../../../../../jdk/java/lang/invoke/lambda/LambdaEagerInitTest.java
+ * @run driver jdk.test.lib.helpers.ClassFileInstaller -jar app.jar
+  *               LambdaEagerInitTest LambdaEagerInitTest$H jdk.test.lib.Asserts
+ * @run driver AOTLambdaEagerInitTest AOT
+ */
+
+import jdk.test.lib.cds.SimpleCDSAppTester;
+import jdk.test.lib.process.OutputAnalyzer;
+
+public class AOTLambdaEagerInitTest {
+    public static void main(String args[]) throws Exception {
+        SimpleCDSAppTester.of("LambdaEagerInitTest")
+            .addVmArgs("-Djdk.internal.lambda.disableEagerInitialization=true")
+            .classpath("app.jar")
+            .appCommandLine("LambdaEagerInitTest")
+            .setAssemblyChecker((OutputAnalyzer out) -> {
+                    out.shouldMatch("warning.*aot.* Disabled AOTInvokeDynamicLinking because jdk.internal.lambda.disableEagerInitialization is set to true");
+                })
+            .runAOTWorkflow();
+    }
+}
